name: Citizenship via Permanent Residence (Naturalisation)

requirements.blocker_text: Must have held legal permanent resident status for 10 years, including the 12 months immediately preceding the application.
requirements.fix_path: Hold Certificate of Permanent Residence status continuously for 10 years.

requirements.blocker_text: A minimum of 6 years residing in The Bahamas prior to the 10-year permanent-residency period is also required.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 6 years of residence in The Bahamas before qualifying for Permanent Residence.

evidence_required.document: Certificate of Permanent Residence held for 10+ years
Proof of 6 years' residence prior to PR
Two character references (from a Bahamian knowing applicant 5+ years)

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Pathways to Bahamian Citizenship: Permanent Residence Route (Form II or III), requiring 10 years as a legal permanent resident (including the 12 months immediately before application) plus a minimum 6 years' residence in The Bahamas prior to that 10-year PR period

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. The source's phrasing is genuinely ambiguous about whether the '6 years prior residence' is additional to, or overlapping with, the 10-year PR period -- modelled here as an ADDITIONAL antecedent period (i.e. roughly 16 years of Bahamas ties in total: 6 years building toward PR eligibility, then 10 years holding PR) since that is the more natural reading of 'minimum 6 years residing in The Bahamas prior to the 10-year residency period' -- flagged explicitly as an interpretive judgment call rather than a directly quoted total figure. No separate language, good-character, or civics-knowledge requirement was found on this source (unlike Trinidad and Tobago's naturalisation route) -- may be a gap in the source rather than confirmation such conditions don't exist.
